title: Mount the folio-assistant platform layers
description: Lays down folio-assistant-core and its closure (cat-harness, cat-harness-tools, bootstrap, bootstrap-tools) at <root>/<name>/ from the committed index.lock.json, verifying each against the lock's tree digest, then runs bun install. It reuses cat-harness's own mount-from-lock.ts, fetched alone at the locked cat-harness SHA on a fresh clone. The layers are git-ignored and never committed. --check needs no network: it reports whether every locked layer is on disk and intact.

install.cli: bun, git and curl on PATH
